title: Trump: I ‘Don’t Give a Damn’ About Gas Prices – But Obama Knows Voters Do

Good morning. **Martin** here, delighted to bring you the news you need to
start your week. For your latest Monday-themed musical treat, we have [this
little baggy beauty](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z2tsJPSJyH0).

In today's '**First Draft** ,' we'll take a look at stark contrasts on the
campaign trail: **Donald Trump 's** blunt refusal to shut up about how he's
caused gas prices to spike, to the point of bragging about it, and **Barack
Obama 's** emergence in Ohio and Michigan to apply the stiletto. Oh, and there
was a minor if amusing fuss over Obama's reference to Trump's taste in White
House _redecorations_.

After that, we'll turn to Brazil, where the runoff election between
**President Luiz In acio Lula da Silva** and challenger **Fl avio Bolsonaro**
produced chaos, delay… and a win for Lula, though Bolsonaro Jr. didn't
concede. A day out from election day in Israel, there were plenty of worrying
developments in the Iran war too. Let's jump in.

Rambling on at his midterm rally in Perry, Georgia, on Saturday, Donald Trump
spewed out sentences that contained a frank confession.

Boasting about the** "hundreds of billions, trillions of dollars"** his
administration is supposedly making from oil in Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana,
Venezuela, and Greenland, the president said his **" people"** told him not to
mention it, because, thanks to his war with Iran, the American **" people are
paying a little higher"** for gas and diesel.

**" I could just see the fake headlines,"** Trump said. "**' President Trump
is talking about all the money they're making while people are suffering at
the pump.' That'll be the headline. But I said, 'I don't give a damn. I'm
going to say it. We're making a fricking fortune.'"**

Trump doesn't give a damn that ordinary people are struggling. Ordinary people
are well aware that he and his family and cronies are making a fricking
fortune in office. Such tone-deaf remarks are, of course, typical of the man
whose illegal war led to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, a wider regional
conflagration, and all that punishment at the pump for average Americans.

In Port Huron, Michigan, on Sunday, Trump went back to the well.
